messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — NVIDIA + Redwood co-hosted "GPU Showcase & Marketplace Launch" planning thread. Draft run-of-show below, plus ask list. Please reply with owners. :rocket:

sam: I can take the end-to-end demo (model + infra). Prefer we show a real low-latency use case — retrieval-augmented generation with our Dedicated pool.

liam: I'll own infra/setup. Plan: provision a dedicated instance on our Dedicated cluster, mirror partner image, and run the demo on a pinned model. Need partner SSH creds and region (us-west-2).

ana: Marketing: we need speaker headshots, 2-sentence bios, and a short blurb for the event page. Also need swag counts — how many partner-branded vs Redwood-branded t-shirts/stickers? Deadline EOD Wed.

zara: SI perspective — we'll demo a simple integration flow: SI connector -> marketplace listing -> autoscaling tests. I can script the connector demo and provide a deployment repo.

maya: Running draft run-of-show:
```
00:00 - Intro (maya, 3m)
03:00 - Partner welcome (NVIDIA rep, 5m)
08:00 - Product overview (ana, 5m)
13:00 - Live demo 1: RAG latency demo (sam + liam, 10m)
23:00 - Live demo 2: SI integration & Marketplace flow (zara, 8m)
31:00 - Q&A (panel, 10m)
41:00 - CTA + swag/offer (maya, 4m)
```
Notes: Want to keep under 45 minutes. We should pre-record one demo as fallback.

sam: For the RAG demo, I propose using the open "redwood/longform-7b" quantized variant. If we use continuous KV caching and our prefix cache, we can show 2x token cost savings — I'll prepare numbers.

liam: Need Docker image + model weights + partner driver bits. Can we get a small ephemeral quota on partner GPUs for a rehearse run? @maya can you coordinate with partner ops?

maya: I'll request test quota. Also asking NVIDIA for a dedicated speaker and 20 branded t-shirts + 200 stickers for bookkeeping. Can someone confirm shipping address for partner swag pickup?

ana: Marketing: Redwood will match swag: 20 tees + 200 stickers. Partner shipping address: Redwood HQ — Receiving Dock B, 3rd Ave. I'll DM logistics contact. Also need any logos (SVGs) and brand guidelines asap.

zara: On the SI repo, I'll add a separate branch named marketplace-demo with an infra-as-code script and a README with step-by-step commands. Want the code snippet to be copy/paste-friendly. Will open PR by Tue.

sam: Rehearsals: suggest 2 dry runs — one internal (hosted by us) and one with partner. Internal on Thu 10am PT, partner rehearsal Fri 9am PT. Can we book Zoom + recording? events-bot: please reserve.

events-bot: Reserved Zoom meeting for Thu 2026-02-05 10:00 PT and Fri 2026-02-06 09:00 PT. Recordings enabled. Invites sent to participants.

liam: Action items for infra:
- Provision Dedicated instance and test model (liam) — due Wed EOD
- Provide sample input set and perf script (sam) — due Wed EOD
- Prewarm cache / measure cold vs warm latencies (liam) — due Thu morning

maya: Can we get a small co-marketing blurb for the cloud marketplace listing (AWS/Azure)? One-liner + 2-paragraph description. Who wants to draft?

ana: I'll draft marketplace copy and landing page blurb, will share first pass by Tue noon.

maya: Risks: partner can't commit GPU quota in time OR speaker cancels. Mitigation: pre-record fallback demo and have a Redwood PM cover partner talking points.

sam: Also note live demo network flakiness — we'll show a short clip of the recorded run at the start of the live demo in case of issues.

zara: For the SI integration section, I'd like a 2-min sequence showing a customer flow: deploy connector -> marketplace purchase -> webhook trigger -> autoscale. I need sample credentials and marketplace test tenant.

maya: I'll request partner test tenant + credentials. Also asking compliance for any NDAs before sharing sample dataset.

ana: Reminder — get headshots + bios by Wed, logos + brand guide by Tue. I'll compile an event page draft once I have those.

liam: Can someone add the demo runbook to the runbook repo under /events/gpu-showcase with clear rollback steps? I'll link the infra bits there.

maya: I'll create the runbook page and add links to Sam/Liam/Zara PRs. Final ask: confirm moderator/MC. Any volunteers to moderate the live Q&A?

ana: I can moderate if nobody else volunteers. Comfortable with timekeeping and chat triage.

sam: Works for me. I'll help with technical answers during Q&A.

maya: Great — assigning moderators: ana (primary), sam (backup). I'll follow up with partner re: speaker confirmation + swag pickup schedule. Thanks all :pray:

events-bot: Reminder created — "GPU Showcase rehearsal" Thu 10am PT. RSVP: maya, sam, liam, ana, zara.
